exposure: temperature on the day of presentation
cohort: The study reviewed hospital records of 15928 pregnant women who delivered at Aga Khan secondary hospital, Hyderabad, between 2019 and 2023.
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, including PIH and pre-eclampsia, were more prevalent during the summer season compared to the winter season.
mod_finding: Among the 932 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders, 73.59% underwent caesarean sections while 26.41% had normal vaginal deliveries.
